title: Star fox roguelike
author: spikyness27
selftext:
This has been mostly opus5, with music from suno. I didn't cut this video in the best way, but you can see the progression in chaos from act 1 levels to act 2. this currently scale to 3 acts and has a system to add buffs to every run and after completing a level. completing levels with a gold highlight allows for an item to be equiped to the ship that can be also leveled up starting in act2. 

  
Sorry about the poor cutting of the video together. This still needs quite a bit more work, but I've mostly be doing on the way to work in the morning. this is done also in godot 4.
